evidence_boundary: R09 is a new output/parser recovery contract bound to the immutable R07 42/47 E0 runner failure and the preserved R08 30/36 static checker registry failure. R08's checker, runner, common helper and failure archive are immutable and are not rerun. R07 proved that the hash-bound open-source generator and Xyce 7.10.0 prefixes were built and installed and that Xyce's controlled B-source command returned 0 with a fixed-column .prn value of 1.25 V; the R07 runner defect was its .csv registration/parser. R09 may reuse only those complete prefixes after independent tree and binary hash checks and must use a new output namespace. It may run only Xyce version/license, the scalar B-source self-test and parser-only -syntax on the frozen IGZO behavioral candidate. It must not build, invoke ngspice/AIM-Spice, solve a formal device DC, create formal M01 tables, or run circuit/downstream stages. A passing R09 runner and independent check would establish only tool/output-contract evidence, not an IGZO equation, device curve, physical parameter, experimental calibration or circuit result. M01 remains E0 until the separate formal two-route device-only DC contract passes.
